The blood feuds of the Ignorance days are abolished, and the first blood feud of Rabi’ah bin Harith, who was nursed among Banu Sa’d and killed by Hudhail. The usuries of Ignorance days are abolished, and the first usury (that I abolish) is our usury, the usury due to ‘Abbas bin ‘Abdul-Muttalib. It is all abolished. Fear Allah with regard to women, for you have taken them as a trust from Allah, and intimacy with them has become permissible to you through Allah’s Word. Your rights over them are that they should not allow anyone whom you dislike to sit on your bedding.** If they do that, then hit them, but in a manner that does not cause injury or leave a mark. Their rights over you are that you should provide for them and clothe them in a reasonable manner. I have left behind you something which, if you adhere to it, you will never go astray: the Book of Allah. You will be asked about me. What will you say?’ They said: ‘We bear witness that you have conveyed (the message) and fulfilled (your duty) and offered sincere advice.’ He gestured with his forefinger towards the sky and then towards the people, (and said:) ‘O Allah, bear witness, O Allah bear witness,’ three times. Then Bilal called the Adhan, then the Iqamah, and he prayed Zuhr. Then he made Iqamah and prayed ‘Asr, and he did not offer any prayer between them. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) rode until he came to the place of standing, and he made his she-camel face Sakharat*** with the path in the sand in front of him, and he faced the Qiblah, then he remained standing until the sun had set and the afterglow had lessened somewhat, when the disk of the sun disappeared. Then he seated Usamah bin Zaid behind him and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set out. He pulled Qaswa’s reins tight until her head was touching the saddle, and he gestured with his right hand: ‘O people, calmly, calmly!’ Every time he came to a hill, he released the reins a little so that she could climb. Then he came to Muzdalifah where he prayed Maghrib and ‘Isha’ with one Adhan and two Iqamah, offering no prayer in between. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) lay down until dawn came, and he prayed Fajr, when he saw that morning had come, with one Adhan and one Iqamah. Then he rode Qaswa’ until he came to Al-Mash’ar Al-Haram. He climbed it and praised Allah and proclaimed His greatness and that He is the only One worthy of worship. Then he remained standing until it had become quite bright, then he moved on before the sun rose. He seated Fadl bin ‘Abbas behind him, who was a man with lovely hair, white and handsome. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) moved on, he passed some women riding camels. Fadl started to look at them, so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) put his hand on the other side. Fadl turned his face to the other side to look. When he came to Muhassir, he sped up a little. Then he followed the middle road that brings you out to the biggest Pillar, until he reached the Pillar that is by the tree. He threw seven pebbles, saying the Takbir with each throw, pebbles suitable for Khadhf (i.e., the size of a chickpea) throwing from the bottom of the valley. Then he went to the place of slaughter, and slaughtered sixty-three camels with his own hand. Then he handed it over to ‘Ali who slaughtered the rest, and he gave him a share in his sacrificial animal. Then he ordered that a piece from each camel be brought; (the pieces) were put in a pot and cooked, and they (the Prophet (ﷺ) and ‘Ali) ate from the meat and drank from the soup. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) hastened to the House, and prayed Zuhr in Makkah. He came to Banu ‘Abdul-Muttalib, who were providing water to the pilgrims at Zamzam, and said: ‘Draw me some water, O Banu ‘Abdul-Muttalib. Were it not that the people would overwhelm you, I would have drawn water with you.’ So they drew up a bucket for him and he drank from it.’” * It appears that the speaker is Ja’far bin Muhammad who is narrating from his father, from Jabir. **And they say that the meaning if ‘your furniture’ or, ‘your special place’ in which case the objective is to say that the wife is not to admit anyone in the house whom the husband would be displeased with. ***Sakharat plural of Sakhrah rock or boulder. Nawawi said: “They are the rocks that lay at the base of the Mount of Mercy, and it is the mount in the middle of ‘Arafat.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ja'far bin Muhammad apne walid ke hawale se bayaan karte hain: Hum Jabir bin Abdullah ke paas gaye, aur jab hum unke paas pahunche unhone logon ke baare mein poocha. Jab woh mujh tak pahunche, maine kaha: Main Muhammad bin Ali bin Husain hoon. Unhone apna haath mere sar ki taraf badhaaya, aur mera oopar ka button khola, fir neeche ka button khola. Fir unhone apna haath mere seene par rakha, aur us waqt main ek jawaan ladka tha. Fir unhone kaha: Tumhaara khair-maqdam ho, jo poochna chaaho poocho. So maine unse poocha, aur woh andhe the. Namaz ka waqt aaya, so woh khade hue, ek buni hui chaadar apne gird lapete hue. Jab bhi woh use apne kandhon par daalte, uske kinaare oopar aa jaate, kyunki woh bahut chhoti thi. Aur unka chogha unke paas ek khoonti par tha. Unhone humein namaz padhaayi, fir unhone kaha: Humein Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki Hajj ke baare mein bataao. Unhone apne haath uthaaye, nau ungliyaan dikhaate hue, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) nau saal tak bina Hajj kiye rahe, fir daswe saal logon ko elaan kiya gaya ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) Hajj ke liye ja rahe hain. So bahut se log Madina aaye, sab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki pairvi karna aur jo woh karte the woh karna chaahte hue. Woh nikle aur hum unke saath nikle, aur hum Dhul-Hulaifah pahunche jahan Asma bint Umais ne Muhammad bin Abu Bakr ko paida kiya. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko khabar bheji poochte hue ke unhein kya karna chaahiye. Unhone farmaya: Ghusl karo, apni kamar ke gird kapda baandho, aur Ihram baandho. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne masjid mein namaz padhi, fir woh Qaswa par sawaar hue jab tak, jab unki oontni Baida par unke saath uthi, Jabir kehte hain: Jahan tak main dekh sakta tha, maine logon ko unke aage sawaar aur paidal chalte dekha, aur maine yehi unki daayin aur baayin taraf, aur unke peechhe bhi dekha, aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) humaare beech the aur unpar Quran nazil ho raha tha, aur woh iska matlab samajhte the. Jo bhi unhone kiya, humne bhi kiya. Fir unhone tawheed ki Talbiyah shuru ki: Labbaika Allahumma labbaik, labbaika la sharika laka labbaik. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika laka. Aur logon ne unke alfaaz dohraaye. Aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne isse pasand kiya. Aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) Talbiyah padhte rahe. Jabir kehte hain: Humaara iraada sirf Hajj tha. Humein Umrah ka pata nahi tha. Fir jab hum unke saath Ghar tak pahunche, unhone Kone ko chhoya, aur teen chakkaron mein tez chale aur chaar mein aam raftaar se. Fir woh Ibrahim ki jagah par khade hue aur kaha: Aur Ibrahim ki jagah ko namaz ki jagah banaao. Woh khade hue is jagah ko apne aur Ghar ke beech rakhte hue. Mere walid kaha karte the: Aur mujhe nahi lagta unhone iska zikr Nabi (ﷺ) se hi kiya ho: Ke woh un do rakaton mein padhte the: Kaho: Ae kaafiro! aur Kaho: Woh Allah hai, ek. Fir woh Ghar ki taraf wapas gaye aur Kone ko chhoya, fir woh darwaze se Safa ki taraf nikle. Jab woh Safa ke qareeb pahunche, unhone padha: Beshak, Safa aur Marwah Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain, aur kaha: Hum wahin se shuru karenge jahan se Allah ne shuru kiya. So unhone Safa se shuru kiya aur uspar chadhe jab tak woh Ghar dekh sakein, fir Allah ki azmat aur Tahlil aur uski tareef ki, aur unhone kaha: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku, wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumit wa huwa ala kulli shai'in Qadir. La ilaha illallah wahdahu, La sharika lahu anjaza wa'dahu, wa nasara abduhu, wa hazamal-Ahzaba wahdahu. Aur unhone yeh teen martaba kaha, beech mein dua karte hue. Fir woh Marwah ki taraf aam raftaar se chale jab tak, jab woh neeche jaana shuru karte, woh wadi ke neeche mein tez chalte. Jab woh chadhaai shuru karte, woh aam raftaar se chalte, jab tak woh Marwah tak nahi pahunche, aur unhone Marwah par woh kiya jo unhone Safa par kiya tha. Apne Sa'y ke aakhir mein, Marwah par unhone kaha: Agar mujhe pehle pata hota jo ab pata hai, main qurbaani ke jaanwar ko haar na pehnaata, aur main ise Umrah bana leta. Tum mein se jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar na ho, use Ihram se bahar aa kar ise Umrah bana lena chaahiye. So sab log Ihram se bahar aa gaye aur apne baal kaate, siwaye Nabi (ﷺ) ke aur un logon ke jinke paas qurbaani ke jaanwar the. Suraqah bin Malik bin Ju'shum khade hue aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool! Kya yeh sirf is saal ke liye hai, ya hamesha ke liye? Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apni ungliyaan aapas mein jodi aur kaha: Umrah Hajj mein aise shaamil hai, do baar. Nahi, yeh hamesha ke liye hai. Ali Nabi (ﷺ) ke oont laaye, aur unhone paaya ke Fatimah un logon mein se thi jo Ihram se bahar aa gayi thi. Unhone rangaa hua kapda pehna tha aur surma lagaaya tha. Ali ne unke iss amal ko na-pasand kiya, lekin unhone kaha: Mere walid ne mujhe aisa karne ko kaha. Ali Iraq mein kaha karte the: So main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas gaya, Fatimah se pareshaan hokar jo unhone kiya tha uski wajah se, Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se poochne ke liye jo unhone kaha tha ke unhone kaha, aur ke mujhe yeh na-pasand tha. Unhone farmaya: Usne sach kaha, usne sach kaha. Tumne apni Hajj shuru karte waqt kya kaha tha? Unhone kaha: Maine kaha: Ae Allah, main Talbiyah shuru karta hoon usi ke liye jiske liye tera Rasool Talbiyah shuru karta hai. Unhone kaha: Aur mere paas qurbaani ka jaanwar hai, so Ihram se bahar mat aao. Unhone kaha: Ali jo qurbaani ke jaanwar Yemen se laaye the aur jo Nabi (ﷺ) Madina se laaye the, unki kul tadaad sau thi. Fir sab log Ihram se bahar aa gaye aur apne baal kaate, siwaye Nabi (ﷺ) ke aur un logon ke jinke paas qurbaani ke jaanwar the. Jab Tarwiyah ka din aaya, woh Mina ki taraf gaye aur Hajj ke liye Talbiyah shuru ki. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) sawaar hue. Unhone Mina mein Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, aur Fajr padhi. Fir woh thodi der thehre jab tak suraj nikla, aur unhone hukum diya ke unke liye Namirah mein bakri ke baal ka ek khaima lagaaya jaaye. Fir Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) rawaana hue, aur Quraish ko yaqeen tha ke woh Al-Mash'ar Haram ya Al-Muzdalifah mein rukenge, jaise Quraish Jahiliyat ke daur mein kiya karte the. Lekin Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) aage badhte rahe jab tak woh Arafat pahunche, jahan unhone paaya ke unke liye khaima Namirah mein lagaaya gaya tha, aur woh wahan ruke. Fir jab suraj apne zenith se guzar chuka, unhone Qaswa ko bulwaaya aur uspar zeen kasi gayi. Woh sawaar hue jab tak woh wadi ke nichle hisse tak pahunche, aur unhone logon se khitaab kiya aur farmaya: Tumhaara khoon aur tumhaara maal tumhaare liye utne hi muqaddas hain jitna tumhaara yeh din, is mahine mein, is zameen mein. Jahiliyat ke daur ki har baat khatm hai, mere in dono paanvon ke neeche. Jahiliyat ke daur ke khoon ke jhagde khatm hain, aur pehla khoon ka jhagda Rabi'ah bin Harith ka, jinhein Banu Sa'd ne paala aur Hudhail ne qatl kiya. Jahiliyat ke daur ke sood khatm hain, aur pehla sood jo main khatm karta hoon humaara sood hai, Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ka sood. Yeh sab khatm hai. Auraton ke maamle mein Allah se daro, kyunki tumne unhein Allah ki amaanat ke tor par liya hai, aur unke saath qurbat Allah ke kalime ke zariye tumhaare liye jaayez hui hai. Unpar tumhaara haq yeh hai ke woh kisi aise shakhs ko na baithne dein jisse tum na-khush ho tumhaare bistar par. Agar woh aisa karein, to unhein maaro, lekin aise tareeke se jisse zakhm ya nishaan na lage. Tumpar unka haq yeh hai ke tum unhein munaasib tareeke se khaana aur kapda do. Maine tumhaare peechhe kuch chhoda hai jise agar tum tham kar rakho, tum kabhi gumraah nahi hoge: Allah ki Kitaab. Tumse mere baare mein poocha jaayega. Tum kya kahoge? Unhone kaha: Hum gawaahi dete hain ke aapne paighaam pahuncha diya, apna farz poora kiya, aur khaalis mashwara diya. Unhone apni tarjani ungli aasmaan ki taraf aur fir logon ki taraf ishaara ki, aur kaha: Ae Allah, gawaah reh, Ae Allah gawaah reh, teen martaba. Fir Bilal ne Azaan kaha, fir Iqamat, aur unhone Zuhr padhi. Fir unhone Iqamat kaha aur Asr padhi, aur unhone unke beech koi namaz nahi padhi. Fir Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) sawaar hue jab tak woh khade hone ki jagah tak pahunche, aur unhone apni oontni ka munh Sakharat ki taraf kiya, rait ka raasta unke saamne, aur unhone Qibla ki taraf munh kiya, fir woh khade rahe jab tak suraj dhal gaya aur shafaq kuch kam ho gayi, jab suraj ki tashteri gayab ho gayi. Fir unhone Usamah bin Zaid ko apne peechhe bithaaya aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) rawaana hue. Unhone Qaswa ki lagaam kas ke pakdi jab tak uska sar zeen ko chhoo raha tha, aur unhone apne daaye haath se ishaara kiya: Ae logo, sukoon se, sukoon se! Har baar jab woh kisi pahaadi tak pahunchte, woh lagaam thodi dheeli kar dete taake woh chadh sake. Fir woh Muzdalifah pahunche jahan unhone Maghrib aur Isha ek Azaan aur do Iqamat ke saath padhi, beech mein koi namaz nahi. Fir Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) fajr tak lete rahe, aur unhone Fajr padhi, jab unhone dekha ke subah ho chuki hai, ek Azaan aur ek Iqamat ke saath. Fir woh Qaswa par sawaar hue jab tak woh Al-Mash'ar Al-Haram tak pahunche. Woh uspar chadhe aur Allah ki tareef ki aur uski azmat bayaan ki aur ke woh akela ibaadat ke laayak hai. Fir woh khade rahe jab tak achhi tarah roshni ho gayi, fir woh aage badhe suraj ugne se pehle. Unhone Fadl bin Abbas ko apne peechhe bithaaya, jo ek khoobsurat baalon waale, gore aur khoobsurat aadmi the. Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) aage badhe, woh kuch oont par sawaar auraton ke paas se guzre. Fadl unhein dekhne lage, so Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apna haath doosri taraf rakha. Fadl ne apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya dekhne ke liye. Jab woh Muhassir tak pahunche, unhone thodi tezi badhaayi. Fir unhone beech ka raasta liya jo tumhein sabse badi Satoon tak le jaata hai, jab tak woh us Satoon tak pahunche jo darakht ke paas hai. Unhone saat kankad phenke, har phenk ke saath Takbir kehte hue, Khadhf ke laayak kankad, wadi ke nichle hisse se phenkte hue. Fir woh zibah ki jagah gaye, aur apne haath se tirsath oont zibah kiye. Fir unhone yeh Ali ko de diya jinhone baaki zibah kiye, aur unhein apni qurbaani mein hissa diya. Fir unhone hukum diya ke har oont se ek tukda laaya jaaye; unhein ek deg mein daala gaya aur pakaaya gaya, aur unhone gosht khaaya aur shorba piya. Fir Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) Ghar ki taraf tezi se gaye, aur Makkah mein Zuhr padhi. Woh Banu Abdul Muttalib ke paas aaye, jo Hajiyon ko Zamzam se paani pila rahe the, aur kaha: Mere liye paani nikaalo, Ae Banu Abdul Muttalib. Agar log tum par bhaar na daalte, main tumhaare saath paani nikaalta. So unhone unke liye ek baalti nikaali aur unhone usse piya.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَاطِبٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ لِلْحَجِّ عَلَى أَنْوَاعٍ ثَلاَثَةٍ فَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ وَعُمْرَةٍ مَعًا وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ مُفْرَدٍ وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ مُفْرَدَةٍ ‏.‏ فَمَنْ كَانَ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ وَعُمْرَةٍ مَعًا لَمْ يَحْلِلْ مِنْ شَىْءٍ مِمَّا حَرُمَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ مَنَاسِكَ الْحَجِّ وَمَنْ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ مُفْرَدًا لَمْ يَحْلِلْ مِنْ شَىْءٍ مِمَّا حَرُمَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ مَنَاسِكَ الْحَجِّ وَمَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ مُفْرَدَةٍ فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ حَلَّ مَا حَرُمَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَقْبِلَ حَجًّا ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:“We went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for Hajj in three ways. Some of us began the Talbiyah for Hajj and ‘Umrah together, some of us began the Talbiyah for Hajj on its own, and some of us began the Talbiyah for ‘Umrah on its own. Those who began the Talbiyah for Hajj and ‘Umrah together did not exit Ihram at all until they had completed the rites of Hajj. Those who began the Talbiyah for Hajj on its own did not exit ihram at all until they had completed the rites of Hajj. And those who began the Talbiyah for ‘Umrah on its own circumambulated the House and ran between Safa and Marwah, then whatever had been forbidden to them became permissible until the time for Hajj came.”
25.hi: Hazrat Aisha bayaan karti hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath Hajj ke liye teen tareekon se nikle. Humme se kuch ne Hajj aur Umrah ek saath ke liye Talbiyah shuru ki, kuch ne sirf Hajj ke liye, aur kuch ne sirf Umrah ke liye. Jinhone Hajj aur Umrah ek saath ke liye Talbiyah shuru ki woh bilkul Ihram se bahar nahi aaye jab tak unhone Hajj ke sab arkaan poore nahi kar liye. Jinhone sirf Hajj ke liye Talbiyah shuru ki woh bhi bilkul Ihram se bahar nahi aaye jab tak unhone Hajj ke sab arkaan poore nahi kar liye. Aur jinhone sirf Umrah ke liye Talbiyah shuru ki, unhone Ghar ka Tawaaf kiya aur Safa aur Marwah ke beech daude, fir jo kuch unke liye haraam tha woh jaayez ho gaya jab tak Hajj ka waqt nahi aaya.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبَّادٍ الْمُهَلَّبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَجَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ثَلاَثَ حَجَّاتٍ حِجَّتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُهَاجِرَ وَحَجَّةً بَعْدَ مَا هَاجَرَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ وَقَرَنَ مَعَ حَجَّتِهِ عُمْرَةً وَاجْتَمَعَ مَا جَاءَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَمَا جَاءَ بِهِ عَلِيٌّ مِائَةَ بَدَنَةٍ مِنْهَا جَمَلٌ لأَبِي جَهْلٍ فِي أَنْفِهِ بُرَةٌ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَنَحَرَ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ بِيَدِهِ ثَلاَثًا وَسِتِّينَ وَنَحَرَ عَلِيٌّ مَا غَبَرَ ‏.‏ قِيلَ لَهُ مَنْ ذَكَرَهُ قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ وَابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏
25.en: Sufyan said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed Hajj three times, twice before he emigrated, and once after he had emigrated, and once after he had emigrated to Al-Madinah. He performed ‘Umrah along with his Hajj. The total number of camels brought by the Prophet (ﷺ) and ‘Ali was one hundred. Among them was a (male) camel belonging to Abu Jahl, which had a silver ring in its nose. The Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered sixty-three with his own hand, and ‘Ali slaughtered the rest.”
25.hi: Hazrat Sufyan bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne teen baar Hajj kiya, do baar Hijrat se pehle, aur ek baar Hijrat ke baad, aur Madina ki taraf Hijrat karne ke baad. Unhone apni Hajj ke saath Umrah bhi kiya. Nabi (ﷺ) aur Ali ke laaye hue oonton ki kul tadaad sau thi. Unmein Abu Jahl ka ek nar oont bhi tha, jiske naak mein chandi ki ek anguthi thi. Nabi (ﷺ) ne apne haath se tirsath zibah kiye, aur Ali ne baaki zibah kiye.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، عُلَيَّةَ عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عِكْرِمَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كُسِرَ أَوْ عَرِجَ فَقَدْ حَلَّ وَعَلَيْهِ حَجَّةٌ أُخْرَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، وَأَبَا، هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَالاَ صَدَقَ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from ‘Ikrimah:“Hajjaj bin ‘Amr Ansari narrated to me, he said: ‘I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say: “Whoever breaks a bone or becomes lame, has exited Ihram, but he must perform another Hajj.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ikrimah se riwayat hai: Hajjaj bin Amr Ansari ne mujhe bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Nabi (ﷺ) ko yeh farmaate suna: Jo koi haddi tod le ya langda ho jaaye, uska Ihram khatm ho jaata hai, lekin use doosri baar Hajj karni hogi.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، - مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ - قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الْحَجَّاجَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو عَنْ حَبْسِ الْمُحْرِمِ فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كُسِرَ أَوْ مَرِضَ أَوْ عَرِجَ فَقَدْ حَلَّ وَعَلَيْهِ الْحَجُّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عِكْرِمَةُ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، وَأَبَا، هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَالاَ صَدَقَ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ فِي جُزْءِ هِشَامٍ صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ مَعْمَرًا فَقَرَأَ عَلَىَّ أَوْ قَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from ‘Ikrimah, from ‘Abdullah bin Rafi’, the freed slave of Umm Salamah, that he said:“I asked Hajjaj bin ‘Amr about a Muhrim being prevented (from completing Hajj). He said: ‘The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever breaks a bone, falls sick or becomes lame, has exited Ihram, and he has to perform Hajj the following year.” 'Ikrimah (a subnarrator) said: I narrated it to Ibn 'Abbas and Abu Hurairah. They said he spoke the truth
25.hi: Hazrat Ikrimah, Abdullah bin Rafi, Umm Salamah ke azaad-karda ghulam, se riwayat karte hain ke unhone kaha: Maine Hajjaj bin Amr se Muhrim ke rokne ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Jo koi haddi tod le, bimaar ho jaaye, ya langda ho jaaye, uska Ihram khatm ho jaata hai, aur use agle saal Hajj karni hogi. Ikrimah, raawi, kehte hain: Maine yeh Ibn Abbas aur Abu Hurairah ko bataayi. Unhone kaha unhone sach kaha.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْقِلٍ، قَالَ قَعَدْتُ إِلَى كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ، ‏{فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ}‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَعْبٌ فِيَّ أُنْزِلَتْ كَانَ بِي أَذًى مِنْ رَأْسِي فَحُمِلْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَالْقَمْلُ يَتَنَاثَرُ عَلَى وَجْهِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا كُنْتُ أُرَى الْجُهْدَ بَلَغَ مِنْكَ مَا أَرَى أَتَجِدُ شَاةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ}‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَالصَّوْمُ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ وَالصَّدَقَةُ عَلَى سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ نِصْفُ صَاعٍ مِنْ طَعَامٍ وَالنُّسُكُ شَاةٌ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Ma’qil said:“I sat with Ka’b bin ‘Ujrah in the mosque and asked him about this Verse: ‘He must pay a compensation of either fasting (three days) or giving charity (feeding six poor persons) or offering sacrifice (one sheep).’ [2:196] Ka’b said: it was revealed concerning me. I had trouble with my head, so I was carried to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), with lice crawling on my face. He said: ‘I did not think that you were suffering as much as I see. Do you have a sheep?’ I said: ‘No.’ Then this Verse was revealed: “He must pay a Fidyah (ransom) of either fasting (three days) or giving Sadaqah (charity – feeding six poor persons) or offering sacrifice (one sheep).” [2:196] He said: ‘Fasting is three days, charity is to be given to six poor persons, giving each one half of a Sa’ of food, and the sacrifice is a sheep.’”
25.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Ma'qil bayaan karte hain: Main Ka'b bin Ujrah ke saath masjid mein baitha aur unse iss aayat ke baare mein poocha: 'Use fidya dena hoga, roze ka, ya sadqe ka, ya qurbaani ka.' Ka'b ne kaha: Yeh mere baare mein nazil hui. Mujhe apne sar mein museebat thi, so mujhe Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas le jaaya gaya, jooein mere chehre par rengti hui. Unhone farmaya: Mujhe nahi laga tumhein itni takleef hai jitni main dekh raha hoon. Kya tumhaare paas ek bakri hai? Maine kaha: Nahi. Fir yeh aayat nazil hui: 'Use fidya dena hoga, roze ka, ya sadqe ka, ya qurbaani ka.' Unhone farmaya: Roza teen din hai, sadqa chhe ghareebon ko diya jaana chaahiye, har ek ko aadha Sa khaana, aur qurbaani ek bakri hai.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، قَالَ أَمَرَنِي النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ حِينَ آذَانِي الْقَمْلُ أَنْ أَحْلِقَ رَأْسِي وَأَصُومَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ أُطْعِمَ سِتَّةَ مَسَاكِينَ وَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَنْ لَيْسَ عِنْدِي مَا أَنْسُكُ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that Ka’b bin ‘Ujrah said:“The Prophet (ﷺ) commanded me, when I was suffering, from live, to shave my head and fast for three days or feed six poor persons. He knew that I did not have an animal I could sacrifice.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ka'b bin Ujrah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne mujhe hukum diya, jab main jooeon ki wajah se pareshaan tha, ke main apna sar mundwaaun aur teen din roza rakhoon ya chhe ghareebon ko khilaaun. Unhein pata tha ke mere paas koi jaanwar nahi tha jise main qurbaan kar sakoon.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ مُحْرِمٌ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet (ﷺ) was treated with cupping when he was fasting and in the state of Ihram
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ka hijaama hua jab woh roza rakhe hue the aur Ihram mein the.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ أَبُو بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي الضَّيْفِ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ مِنْ رَهْصَةٍ أَخَذَتْهُ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Jabir that the Prophet (ﷺ) was treated with cupping when he was in the state of Ihram, because he did not feel well
25.hi: Hazrat Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ka hijaama hua jab woh Ihram mein the, kyunki unhein theek nahi lag raha tha.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ فَرْقَدٍ السَّبَخِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ كَانَ يَدَّهِنُ رَأْسَهُ بِالزَّيْتِ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ غَيْرَ الْمُقَتَّتِ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to put oil on his head when he was in the state of Ihram, but not oil that was perfumed
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) apne sar par tel lagaate the jab woh Ihram mein hote, lekin khushbu-daar tel nahi.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَوْقَصَتْهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏"‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْهِ وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا وَجْهَهُ وَلاَ رَأْسَهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، مِثْلَهُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَعْقَصَتْهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُقَرِّبُوهُ طِيبًا فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that a man’s neck was broken by his mount (from falling) while he was in the state of Ihram. The Prophet (ﷺ) said:“Wash him with water and lote leaves, and shroud him in his two garments, but do not cover his face or his head, for he will be raised on the Day of Resurrection reciting the Talbiyah.” Another chain reports the same except a different verb was used for the break of the neck and he said "do not bring him near perfume, for he will be raised on the Day of Resurrection reciting the Talbiyah.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai: Ek aadmi ki gardan uski sawaari se girkar toot gayi jab woh Ihram mein tha. Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Use paani aur bair ke patton se dho lo, aur use uski do chaadaron mein kafan do, lekin uska chehra ya sar mat dhaanko, kyunki woh Qayamat ke din Talbiyah padhte hue uthaaya jaayega. Doosri sanad waisi hi hai siwaye ke gardan toot ne ke liye alag lafz istemal hua aur unhone kaha: Usse khushbu ke qareeb mat lao, kyunki woh Qayamat ke din Talbiyah padhte hue uthaaya jaayega.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ جَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فِي الضَّبُعِ يُصِيبُهُ الْمُحْرِمُ كَبْشًا وَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّيْدِ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that Jabir said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stipulated (the penalty of) a man for a hyena killed by a man in Ihram, and he considered it as game.”
25.hi: Hazrat Jabir bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne ek aadmi ke liye ek lakdbaggha ke muaawze ka faisla diya jise ek Ihram mein aadmi ne qatl kiya tha, aur unhone use shikaar maana.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْقَطَّانُ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ مَوْهَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَزِّمِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ فِي بَيْضِ النَّعَامِ يُصِيبُهُ الْمُحْرِمُ ‏ "‏ ثَمَنُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, concerning an ostrich egg taken by a Muhrim:“Its cost (must be paid as a penalty).”
25.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne, Muhrim ke liye jo shuturmurgh ka anda le, farmaya: Uski qeemat ada karni hogi.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ فَوَاسِقُ يُقْتَلْنَ فِي الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ الْحَيَّةُ وَالْغُرَابُ الأَبْقَعُ وَالْفَأْرَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ وَالْحِدَأَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“There are five vermin that might be killed whether one is in or outside the sacred precincts: the snake, the speckled crow, the mouse, the vicious dog, and the kite.”
25.hi: Hazrat Aisha se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Paanch zeher-naak jaanwar hain jinhein qatl kiya ja sakta hai, chahe koi Haram mein ho ya bahar: Saanp, chittidaar kauwa, chuha, khatarnaak kutta, aur cheel.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ لاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَى مَنْ قَتَلَهُنَّ - أَوْ قَالَ فِي قَتْلِهِنَّ - وَهُوَ حَرَامٌ الْعَقْرَبُ وَالْغُرَابُ وَالْحِدَأَةُ وَالْفَأْرَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“There are five animals, for which there is no sin on a person if he kills them” – or he said: “if he kills them when in Ihram – the scorpion, the crow, the kite, the mouse and the vicious dog.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Paanch jaanwar hain, jinhein qatl karne mein kisi shakhs par koi gunah nahi, ya unhone kaha: Agar woh unhein Ihram mein qatl kare, bichhoo, kauwa, cheel, chuha, aur khatarnaak kutta.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نُعْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَقْتُلُ الْمُحْرِمُ الْحَيَّةَ وَالْعَقْرَبَ وَالسَّبُعَ الْعَادِيَ وَالْكَلْبَ الْعَقُورَ وَالْفَأْرَةَ الْفُوَيْسِقَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لَهُ لِمَ قِيلَ لَهَا الْفُوَيْسِقَةُ قَالَ لأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ اسْتَيْقَظَ لَهَا وَقَدْ أَخَذَتِ الْفَتِيلَةَ لِتُحْرِقَ بِهَا الْبَيْتَ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:‘The one in Ihram may kill the snake, the scorpion, the aggressive predator, the vicious dog and the harmful mouse.” It was said to him: “Why is it said that they are harmful?” He said:* “Because the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) woke up because of one, and it had taken the wick (of the lamp) to burn down the house.”
25.hi: Hazrat Abu Sa'eed se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ihram waala saanp, bichhoo, hamla-aawar shikaari, khatarnaak kutta, aur nuqsaan-deh chuha qatl kar sakta hai. Unse poocha gaya: Inhein nuqsaan-deh kyun kaha jaata hai? Unhone farmaya: Kyunki Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ek ki wajah se jaage the, aur usne battii le li thi ghar ko jalaane ke liye.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَهِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا صَعْبُ بْنُ جَثَّامَةَ، قَالَ مَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَأَنَا بِالأَبْوَاءِ أَوْ بِوَدَّانَ فَأَهْدَيْتُ لَهُ حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ فَرَدَّهُ عَلَىَّ فَلَمَّا رَأَى فِي وَجْهِيَ الْكَرَاهِيَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِنَا رَدٌّ عَلَيْكَ وَلَكِنَّا حُرُمٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:“Sa;b bin Jaththamah told us: ‘The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed by me when I was in Abwa’ or Waddan, and I gave him some meat of a wild donkey, but he gave it back to me, and when he saw from my face that I was upset, he said: ‘The only reason that we are giving it back is that we are in Ihram.’”
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas bayaan karte hain: Sa'b bin Jaththamah ne humein bataya: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) mere paas se guzre jab main Abwa ya Waddan mein tha, aur maine unhein jangli gadhe ka kuch gosht diya, lekin unhone use mujhe wapas kar diya, aur jab unhone mere chehre se dekha ke main pareshaan hoon, unhone farmaya: Isse wapas karne ki sirf wajah yeh hai ke hum Ihram mein hain.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ بِلَحْمِ صَيْدٍ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَلَمْ يَأْكُلْهُ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that ‘Ali bin Abu Talib said:“The Prophet (ﷺ) brought some meat from some game when he was in Ihram, and he did not eat it.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas kuch shikaar ka gosht laaya gaya jab woh Ihram mein the, aur unhone use nahi khaaya.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَعْطَاهُ حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُفَرِّقَهُ فِي الرِّفَاقِ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Talhah bin ‘Ubaidullah that the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him some wild donkey meat, and told him to distribute it among his Companions, who were in Ihram
25.hi: Hazrat Talhah bin Ubaidullah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne unhein jangli gadhe ka gosht diya, aur unhein hukum diya ke woh use apne sahaba mein baant den, jo Ihram mein the.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَأَحْرَمَ أَصْحَابُهُ وَلَمْ أُحْرِمْ فَرَأَيْتُ حِمَارًا فَحَمَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَاصْطَدْتُهُ فَذَكَرْتُ شَأْنَهُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَذَكَرْتُ أَنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ أَحْرَمْتُ وَأَنِّي إِنَّمَا اصْطَدْتُهُ لَكَ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَصْحَابَهُ فَأَكَلُوا وَلَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ حِينَ أَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنِّي اصْطَدْتُهُ لَهُ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Abu Qatadah that his father said:“I went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at the time of Hudaibiyah, and his Companions entered Ihram, but I did not. I saw a donkey do I hunted it. I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and told him: ‘I had not entered Ihram, and I was hunting it for you.’ The Prophet (ﷺ) told his Companions to eat it, but he did not eat from it, because I told him that I had hunted it for him.”
25.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abu Qatadah apne walid ke hawale se bayaan karte hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath Hudaibiyah ke waqt nikla, aur unke sahaba ne Ihram baandha, lekin maine nahi baandha. Maine ek gadha dekha aur uska shikaar kiya. Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se kiya aur unhein bataaya: Maine Ihram nahi baandha tha, aur main aapke liye iska shikaar kar raha tha. Nabi (ﷺ) ne apne sahaba ko use khaane ko kaha, lekin unhone khud usmein se nahi khaaya, kyunki maine unhein bataya tha ke maine iska shikaar unke liye kiya tha.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَعَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ يُهْدِي مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَأَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْيِهِ ثُمَّ لاَ يَجْتَنِبُ شَيْئًا مِمَّا يَجْتَنِبُ الْمُحْرِمُ ‏.‏
25.en: ‘Aishah the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) said; “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to send the sacrificial animal from Al-Madinah, and I would twist the garlands for his sacrificial animal, then, he would not (because of that) avoid the things that the one in Ihram avoids.”
25.hi: Hazrat Aisha, Nabi (ﷺ) ki biwi, kehti hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) Madina se qurbaani ka jaanwar bhejte, aur main unke qurbaani ke jaanwar ke haar bunti, fir woh iski wajah se un cheezon se nahi bachte the jinse Ihram waala bachta hai.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ الْقَلاَئِدَ لِهَدْىِ النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فَيُقَلِّدُ هَدْيَهُ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ بِهِ ثُمَّ يُقِيمُ لاَ يَجْتَنِبُ شَيْئًا مِمَّا يَجْتَنِبُهُ الْمُحْرِمُ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that ‘Aishah the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“I used to twist the garlands for the sacrificial animal of the Prophet (ﷺ), and his sacrificial animal would be garlanded and sent (to Makkah), and he would stay (in Al-Madinah) without avoiding any of the things that the one in Ihram avoids.”
25.hi: Hazrat Aisha, Nabi (ﷺ) ki biwi, bayaan karti hain: Main Nabi (ﷺ) ke qurbaani ke jaanwar ke haar bunti thi, aur unke qurbaani ke jaanwar ko haar pehnaaya jaata aur bheja jaata, aur woh Madina mein rehte bina un cheezon se bache jinse Ihram waala bachta hai.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَهْدَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ مَرَّةً غَنَمًا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَقَلَّدَهَا ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:“On one occasion the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent sheep to the House, and he garlanded them.”
25.hi: Hazrat Aisha bayaan karti hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne bakriyaan Ghar ki taraf bheji, aur unhein haar pehnaaye.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَسَّانَ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَشْعَرَ الْهَدْىَ فِي السَّنَامِ الأَيْمَنِ وَأَمَاطَ عَنْهُ الدَّمَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَقَلَّدَ نَعْلَيْنِ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet (ﷺ) marked the sacrificial animal on the right side of the hump and wiped away the blood
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne qurbaani ke jaanwar ko kohaan ki daayin taraf nishaan lagaaya aur khoon poncha.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَفْلَحَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَلَّدَ وَأَشْعَرَ وَأَرْسَلَ بِهَا وَلَمْ يَجْتَنِبْ مَا يَجْتَنِبُ الْمُحْرِمُ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet (ﷺ) garlanded, and marked, and sent (the sacrificial animals), but he did not avoid anything that the one in Ihram avoids
25.hi: Hazrat Aisha se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne haar pehnaaya, aur nishaan lagaaya, aur bheja, lekin unhone kisi bhi cheez se parhez nahi kiya jisse Ihram waala parhez karta hai.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَنْ أَقُومَ عَلَى بُدْنِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْسِمَ جِلاَلَهَا وَجُلُودَهَا وَأَنْ لاَ أُعْطِيَ الْجَازِرَ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ نُعْطِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that ‘Ali bin Abu Talib said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded me to look after his sacrificial camels, to share out their covers and skins, and not to give the butcher any of it. He said: ‘We will give him (his wages).’”
25.hi: Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main unke qurbaani ke oonton ki dekh-bhaal karoon, unke covers aur khaalein baant doon, aur qassaab ko usmein se kuch na doon. Unhone farmaya: Hum use uski mazdoori denge.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَهْدَى فِي بُدْنِهِ جَمَلاً لأَبِي جَهْلٍ بُرَتُهُ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that among the sacrificial animals the Prophet (ﷺ) included a (male) camel belonging to Abu Jahl, which had a silver nose ring
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne apne qurbaani ke jaanwaron mein Abu Jahl ka ek oont bhi shaamil kiya, jiski naak mein chandi ki anguthi thi.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَنْبَأَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ كَانَ فِي بُدْنِهِ جَمَلٌ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Iyas bin Salamah, from his father, that the Prophet (ﷺ) had a (male) camel among his sacrificial animals
25.hi: Hazrat Iyas bin Salamah apne walid ke hawale se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) ke qurbaani ke jaanwaron mein ek oont bhi tha.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ اشْتَرَى هَدْيَهُ مِنْ قُدَيْدٍ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet (ﷺ) bought his sacrificial animal from Qudaid
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne apna qurbaani ka jaanwar Qudaid se khareeda.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ رَأَى رَجُلاً يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا وَيْحَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man driving a camel and said:“Ride it.” He said: “It is a sacrificial animal.” He said: “Ride it, woe to you!”
25.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne ek aadmi ko oont haankte dekha aur farmaya: Iske upar sawaar ho. Usne kaha: Yeh ek qurbaani ka jaanwar hai. Unhone farmaya: Iske upar sawaar ho, afsos tumpar!

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، - صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ - عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ مُرَّ عَلَيْهِ بِبَدَنَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُهُ رَاكِبَهَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فِي عُنُقِهَا نَعْلٌ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Prophet (ﷺ) was brought a sacrificial animal and he said (to the man driving the animal):“Ride it.” He said: “It is a sacrificial animal.” He said: “Ride it.” He said: “I saw him riding it with the Prophet (ﷺ), and there was a sandal (tied) around its neck.”
25.hi: Hazrat Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas ek qurbaani ka jaanwar laaya gaya aur unhone farmaya: Iske upar sawaar ho. Usne kaha: Yeh ek qurbaani ka jaanwar hai. Unhone farmaya: Iske upar sawaar ho. Unhone kaha: Maine use Nabi (ﷺ) ke saath sawaar hote dekha, aur uski gardan mein ek joota bandha tha.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سِنَانِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ ذُؤَيْبًا الْخُزَاعِيَّ، حَدَّثَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ كَانَ يَبْعَثُ مَعَهُ بِالْبُدْنِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا عَطِبَ مِنْهَا شَىْءٌ فَخَشِيتَ عَلَيْهِ مَوْتًا فَانْحَرْهَا ثُمَّ اغْمِسْ نَعْلَهَا فِي دَمِهَا ثُمَّ اضْرِبْ صَفْحَتَهَا وَلاَ تَطْعَمْ مِنْهَا أَنْتَ وَلاَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ رُفْقَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that Dhu’aib Al-Khuza’i narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to send the sacrificial animals with him, then he would say:“If any of them becomes unfit and you are afraid that it will die, then slaughter it, dip the sandal (tied around its neck) in its blood and place it on its side, but neither you nor any of your companions should eat anything from it.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Dhu'aib al-Khuza'i ne bataya ke Nabi (ﷺ) unke saath qurbaani ke jaanwar bhejte the, fir woh kehte: Agar unmein se koi bhi bekaar ho jaaye aur tumhein dar ho ke woh mar jaayega, to use zibah karo, joote ko uske khoon mein dubao aur use uski taraf rakh do, lekin na tum aur na tumhaare saathiyon mein se koi usmein se kuch khaaye.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ نَاجِيَةَ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، - قَالَ عَمْرٌو فِي حَدِيثِهِ وَكَانَ صَاحِبَ بُدْنِ النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ - قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ بِمَا عَطِبَ مِنَ الْبُدْنِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ انْحَرْهُ وَاغْمِسْ نَعْلَهُ فِي دَمِهِ ثُمَّ اضْرِبْ صَفْحَتَهُ وَخَلِّ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ النَّاسِ فَلْيَأْكُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that Najiyah Al-Khuza’i – in his narration, ‘Amr (one of the narrators) said that he was the one who looked after the sacrificial animals of the Prophet (ﷺ) – said:“I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, what should I do with those sacrificial animals that become unfit?’ He said: ‘Slaughter them, dip its sandal in its blood, then place it on its side, and leave them for the people to eat.’”
25.hi: Hazrat Najiyah al-Khuza'i bayaan karte hain, unki riwayat mein, Amr, raawiyon mein se ek, kehte hain ke woh Nabi (ﷺ) ke qurbaani ke jaanwaron ki dekh-bhaal karte the, unhone kaha: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, un qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke saath kya karoon jo bekaar ho jaayein? Unhone farmaya: Unhein zibah karo, unka joota unke khoon mein dubao, fir use unki taraf rakh do, aur unhein logon ke khaane ke liye chhod do.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ نَضْلَةَ، قَالَ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَمَا تُدْعَى رِبَاعُ مَكَّةَ إِلاَّ السَّوَائِبَ مَنِ احْتَاجَ سَكَنَ وَمَنِ اسْتَغْنَى أَسْكَنَ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that ‘Alqamah bin Nadlah said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Abu Bakr and ‘Umar died, and the houses in Makkah were still called free. Whoever needed to, lived there, and whoever had no need of them allowed others to live there (without asking for rent).”
25.hi: Hazrat Alqamah bin Nadlah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ), Abu Bakr, aur Umar ka inteqal ho gaya, aur Makkah ke ghar abhi bhi azaad kahe jaate the. Jiske paas zaroorat hoti, woh wahan rehta, aur jise unki zaroorat na hoti woh doosron ko rehne deta.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَدِيِّ بْنِ الْحَمْرَاءِ قَالَ لَهُ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَهُوَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ وَاقِفٌ بِالْحَزْوَرَةِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّكِ لَخَيْرُ أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَأَحَبُّ أَرْضِ اللَّهِ إِلَيَّ وَاللَّهِ لَوْلاَ أَنِّي أُخْرِجْتُ مِنْكِ مَا خَرَجْتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: Abu Salamah bin ‘Abdur-Rahman bin ‘Awf narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Adiy bin Hamra’ said to him:“I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), when he was on his she-camel, standing in Al-Hazwarah* saying: ‘By Allah, you are the best land of Allah, and the dearest of the land of Allah to me. By Allah, had I not been expelled from you I would never have left.’” *A place in Makkah
25.hi: Hazrat Abu Salamah bin Abdur Rahman bin Awf bayaan karte hain ke Abdullah bin Adiy bin Hamra ne unse kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko dekha, jab woh apni oontni par the, Al-Hazwarah mein khade hue yeh kehte hue: Allah ki qasam, tum Allah ki behtareen zameen ho, aur mujhe Allah ki zameenon mein sabse pyari. Allah ki qasam, agar mujhe tumse na nikaala jaata, main kabhi na jaata.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ يَنَّاقٍ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ يَخْطُبُ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ مَكَّةَ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ فَهِيَ حَرَامٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لاَ يُعْضَدُ شَجَرُهَا وَلاَ يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهَا وَلاَ يَأْخُذُ لُقَطَتَهَا إِلاَّ مُنْشِدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ فَإِنَّهُ لِلْبُيُوتِ وَالْقُبُورِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that Safiyyah bint Shaibah said:“I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a sermon in the Year of the Conquest (of Makkah), and he said: ‘O people, Allah made Makkah sacred the day He created the heavens and the earth, and it is sacred until the Day of Resurrection. Its trees are not to be cut, its game is not to be disturbed, and its lost property is not to be taken except by one who will announce it.’‘Abbas said: ‘Except for Idhkhir (a kind of fragrant grass), for it is (used) for houses and graves.’ The messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘Except for Idhkhir.’”
25.hi: Hazrat Safiyyah bint Shaibah bayaan karti hain: Maine Nabi (ﷺ) ko Fatah ke saal khutba dete suna, aur unhone kaha: Ae logo, Allah ne Makkah ko muqaddas banaaya jis din usne aasmaan aur zameen banaaye, aur yeh Qayamat ke din tak muqaddas hai. Iske darakht nahi kaate jaane chaahiye, iska shikaar nahi chheda jaana chaahiye, aur iska khoya hua maal sirf woh le sakta hai jo iska elaan kare. Abbas ne kaha: Siwaye Idhkhir ke, kyunki yeh gharon aur qabron ke liye istemal hoti hai. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Siwaye Idhkhir ke.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، وَابْنُ الْفُضَيْلِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَابِطٍ، عَنْ عَيَّاشِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ الْمَخْزُومِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَزَالُ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا عَظَّمُوا هَذِهِ الْحُرْمَةَ حَقَّ تَعْظِيمِهَا فَإِذَا ضَيَّعُوا ذَلِكَ هَلَكُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from ‘Ayyash bin Abu Rabi’ah (Makhzumi) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:‘The goodness of this nation will not cease as long as they revere this sanctuary* as it is due. But when they lose that reverence, they will be doomed.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ayyash bin Abu Rabi'ah (Makhzumi) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Iss ummat ki bhalaai tab tak khatm nahi hogi jab tak woh iss Haram ki jaise chaahiye waisi izzat karte rahein. Lekin jab woh yeh izzat kho denge, woh barbaad ho jaayenge.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الإِيمَانَ لَيَأْرِزُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ كَمَا تَأْرِزُ الْحَيَّةُ إِلَى جُحْرِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: it was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Faith will retreat to Al-Madinah as a snake retreats to its hole.”
25.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Imaan Madina ki taraf peechhe hatega jaise saanp apne bil ki taraf peechhe hatta hai.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَمُوتَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَفْعَلْ فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ لِمَنْ مَاتَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:‘Whoever among you can die in Al-Madinah, let him do so, for I will bear witness in favor of those who die there.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Tum mein se jo bhi Madina mein mar sakta hai, use aisa karna chaahiye, kyunki main un logon ke haq mein gawaahi dunga jo wahan marte hain.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَرْوَانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الْعُثْمَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ وَإِنَّكَ حَرَّمْتَ مَكَّةَ عَلَى لِسَانِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اللَّهُمَّ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ وَإِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو مَرْوَانَ لاَبَتَيْهَا حَرَّتَىِ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“O Allah! Ibrahim was Your Friend and Prophet, and You declared Makkah to be sacred through Ibrahim. O Allah! I am Your slave and Prophet, and I declare what is between its two lava fields to be sacred.”
25.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Allah! Ibrahim tera dost aur Nabi tha, aur tune Ibrahim ke zariye Makkah ko muqaddas banaaya. Ae Allah! Main tera banda aur Nabi hoon, aur main iske do lava patthar maidanon ke beech ke ilaqe ko muqaddas banaata hoon.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ كَمَا يَذُوبُ الْمِلْحُ فِي الْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Whoever wishes bad upon the people of Al-Madinah, Allah will cause him to melt as salt melts in water.”
25.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Jo koi Madina waalon ke liye buraai chaahta hai, Allah use aise gala dega jaise namak paani mein galta hai.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مِكْنَفٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أُحُدًا جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ وَهُوَ عَلَى تُرْعَةٍ مِنْ تُرَعِ الْجَنَّةِ وَعَيْرٌ عَلَى تُرْعَةٍ مِنْ تُرَعِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Miknaf said:“I heard Anas bin Malik say: ‘The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Uhud is a mountain which loves us and we love it, and it stands at one of the gates of Paradise. And ‘Aer* stands at one of the gates of Hell.’”
25.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Miknaf bayaan karte hain: Maine Anas bin Malik ko yeh kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Uhud ek pahaad hai jo humse mohabbat karta hai aur hum usse mohabbat karte hain, aur yeh Jannat ke ek darwaze par khada hai. Aur Aer Jahannam ke ek darwaze par khada hai.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ الأَحْدَبِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَ رَجُلٌ مَعِيَ بِدَرَاهِمَ هَدِيَّةً إِلَى الْبَيْتِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَخَلْتُ الْبَيْتَ وَشَيْبَةُ جَالِسٌ عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ فَنَاوَلْتُهُ إِيَّاهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَلَكَ هَذِهِ قُلْتُ لاَ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ لِي لَمْ آتِكَ بِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمَا لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ لَقَدْ جَلَسَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ مَجْلِسَكَ الَّذِي جَلَسْتَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ لاَ أَخْرُجُ حَتَّى أَقْسِمَ مَالَ الْكَعْبَةِ بَيْنَ فُقَرَاءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا أَنْتَ بِفَاعِلٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ لأَفْعَلَنَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَلِمَ ذَاكَ قُلْتُ لأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَدْ رَأَى مَكَانَهُ ‏.‏ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَهُمَا أَحْوَجُ مِنْكَ إِلَى الْمَالِ فَلَمْ يُحَرِّكَاهُ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ كَمَا هُوَ فَخَرَجَ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that Shaqiq said:“A man sent some Dirham through me to the House.” He said: “I entered the House and Shaibah was sitting on a chair. I handed it (the money) to him and he said: ‘Is this yours?’ I said: ‘No, if it were mine I would not have given it to you.’ He said: ‘Since you say that, ‘Umar was sitting in the place where you are sitting now and said: “I will not go out until I distribute the wealth of the poor Muslims.” I said: “You will not do that.” He said: “I will certainly do that.” He said: “Why is that?” I said: “Because, the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr saw where it was, and they had more need of the money than you do. But, they did not move it. Then, he stood up just as he was and went out.”
25.hi: Hazrat Shaqiq bayaan karte hain: Ek aadmi ne mere zariye Ghar ke liye kuch dirham bheje. Unhone kaha: Main Ghar mein daakhil hua aur Shaibah ek kursi par baithe the. Maine unhein woh paise diye aur unhone kaha: Kya yeh tumhaare hain? Maine kaha: Nahi, agar yeh mere hote to main tumhein na deta. Unhone kaha: Chunki tum yeh keh rahe ho, Umar usi jagah baithe the jahan ab tum baithe ho aur unhone kaha: Main tab tak nahi jaunga jab tak main ghareeb Musalmanon ka maal taqseem na kar doon. Maine kaha: Tum aisa nahi karoge. Unhone kaha: Main zaroor aisa karunga. Unhone kaha: Kyun? Maine kaha: Kyunki, Nabi (ﷺ) aur Abu Bakr ne dekha ke yeh kahan tha, aur unhein tumse zyada iss maal ki zaroorat thi. Lekin, unhone ise nahi hataaya. Fir, woh waisa hi khade hue jaise the aur bahar chale gaye.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْعَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ الْعَمِّيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَمَضَانَ بِمَكَّةَ فَصَامَ وَقَامَ مِنْهُ مَا تَيَسَّرَ لَهُ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مِائَةَ أَلْفِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِيمَا سِوَاهَا ‏.‏ وَكَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ عِتْقَ رَقَبَةٍ وَكُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ عِتْقَ رَقَبَةٍ وَكُلِّ يَوْمٍ حُمْلاَنَ فَرَسٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَفِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ حَسَنَةً وَفِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ حَسَنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Whoever is in Makkah when the month of Ramadan comes, and he fasts it and prays at night as much as he can, Allah will record for him (reward equivalent to that for) one hundred thousand months of Ramadan observed elsewhere. For each day Allah will record for him (reward equivalent to that for) freeing a slave, and for each day (reward equivalent to that for) providing a horse in the cause of Allah, and for every day merits and for every night merits.”
25.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Jo koi Makkah mein ho jab Ramzan ka mahina aaye, aur woh roza rakhe aur raat ko jitna ho sake namaz padhe, Allah uske liye ek lakh Ramzaanon ke barabar ajr likhega jo kahin aur padhe gaye ho. Har din ke liye Allah uske liye ek ghulam azaad karne ke barabar likhega, aur har din ke liye Allah ki raah mein ek ghoda dene ke barabar, aur har din ke liye neki aur har raat ke liye neki.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْعَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَجْلاَنَ، قَالَ طُفْنَا مَعَ أَبِي عِقَالٍ فِي مَطَرٍ فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا طَوَافَنَا أَتَيْنَا خَلْفَ الْمَقَامِ فَقَالَ طُفْتُ مَعَ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فِي مَطَرٍ فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا الطَّوَافَ أَتَيْنَا الْمَقَامَ فَصَلَّيْنَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ لَنَا أَنَسٌ ‏ "‏ ائْتَنِفُوا الْعَمَلَ فَقَدْ غُفِرَ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ هَكَذَا قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَطُفْنَا مَعَهُ فِي مَطَرٍ ‏.‏
25.en: Dawud bin ‘Ajlan said:“We performed Tawaf with Abu ‘Iqal in the rain, and when we finished our Tawaf, we came behind the Maqam. He said: I performed Tawaf with Anas bin Malik in the rain. When we finished the Tawaf, we came behind the Maqam and prayed two Rak’ah.’ Anas said to us: ‘Start your deeds anew, for you have been forgiven. This is what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to us when we performed Tawaf with him in the rain.’”
25.hi: Hazrat Dawud bin Ajlan bayaan karte hain: Humne Abu Iqal ke saath baarish mein Tawaaf kiya, aur jab humne apna Tawaaf khatm kiya, hum Maqam ke peechhe aaye. Unhone kaha: Maine Anas bin Malik ke saath baarish mein Tawaaf kiya. Jab humne Tawaaf khatm kiya, hum Maqam ke peechhe aaye aur do rakat padhi. Anas ne humse kaha: Apne amal nayi shuruaat karo, kyunki tumhein maaf kar diya gaya hai. Yehi Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humse kaha tha jab humne unke saath baarish mein Tawaaf kiya.

25.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ الأُبُلِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ الزَّيَّاتِ، عَنْ حُمْرَانَ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَجَّ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَأَصْحَابُهُ مُشَاةً مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ارْبُطُوا أَوْسَاطَكُمْ بِأُزُرِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَمَشَى خِلْطَ الْهَرْوَلَةِ ‏.‏
25.en: It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:“The Prophet (ﷺ) and his Companions performed Hajj walking from Al-Madinah to Makkah. He said: ‘Tie your lower garments around your waists,’ and he alternated between walking and jogging.”
25.hi: Hazrat Abu Sa'eed bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) aur unke sahaba ne Madina se Makkah tak paidal chal kar Hajj kiya. Unhone farmaya: Apne neeche ke kapde apni kamar ke gird baandho, aur unhone paidal chalne aur jogging karne ke beech badalte rahe.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ كَانَ يُضَحِّي بِكَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ وَيُسَمِّي وَيُكَبِّرُ وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَذْبَحُ بِيَدِهِ وَاضِعًا قَدَمَهُ عَلَى صِفَاحِهِمَا ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to sacrifice two horned, black-and-white rams and he would say the Name of Allah and pronounce His greatness. I saw him slaughtering them with his own hand, putting his foot on their sides.”
26.hi: Hazrat Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) do sing waale, kaale-safed bhere qurbaan kiya karte the, aur woh Allah ka naam lete aur uski azmat bayaan karte. Maine unhein apne haath se unhein zibah karte dekha, unke pehluon par apna pair rakhte hue.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ ضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ يَوْمَ عِيدٍ بِكَبْشَيْنِ فَقَالَ حِينَ وَجَّهَهُمَا ‏ "‏ إِنِّي وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأُمَّتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sacrificed two rams on the Day of ‘Eid. When he turned them to face towards the prayer direction he said: ‘Verily, I have turned my face towards Him Who has created the heavens and the earth, as a monotheist, and I am not of the polytheists. Verily, my prayer, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of all that exists. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims. [6:79,162-163] O Allah, from You to You, on behalf of Muhammad and his nation.’”
26.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Eid ke din do bhere qurbaan kiye. Jab unhone unhein namaz ki simt mein munh kiya, unhone kaha: 'Beshak, maine apna chehra us Zaat ki taraf kiya hai jisne aasmaan aur zameen banaaye, ek Allah waala hokar, aur main mushrikeen mein se nahi hoon. Beshak, meri namaz, meri qurbaani, mera jeena, aur mera marna Allah ke liye hai, jo tamaam duniyaon ka Rab hai. Uska koi shareek nahi. Aur isi ka mujhe hukum diya gaya hai, aur main Musalmanon mein sabse pehla hoon.' Ae Allah, tere hi paas se, tere hi liye, Muhammad aur unki ummat ki taraf se.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُضَحِّيَ اشْتَرَى كَبْشَيْنِ عَظِيمَيْنِ سَمِينَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ مَوْجُوءَيْنِ فَذَبَحَ أَحَدَهُمَا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ لِمَنْ شَهِدَ لِلَّهِ بِالتَّوْحِيدِ وَشَهِدَ لَهُ بِالْبَلاَغِ وَذَبَحَ الآخَرَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَنْ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated from ‘Aishah and Abu Hurairah that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wanted to offer a sacrifice, he brought two large, fat, horned, black-and-white, castrated rams. He slaughtered one on behalf of his nation, for whoever testified to Allah with monotheism and that he had conveyed (the Message), and he slaughtered the other on behalf of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad (ﷺ)
26.hi: Hazrat Aisha aur Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) qurbaani dena chaahte, woh do bade, mote, sing waale, kaale-safed, khassi kiye hue bhere laate. Unhone ek apni ummat ki taraf se zibah kiya, un sab ke liye jinhone Allah ki tawheed ki gawaahi di aur ke unhone paighaam pahuncha diya, aur unhone doosra Muhammad aur Muhammad ke khaandaan ki taraf se zibah kiya.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ سَعَةٌ وَلَمْ يُضَحِّ فَلاَ يَقْرَبَنَّ مُصَلاَّنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Whoever can afford it, but does not offer a sacrifice, let him not come near our prayer place.”
26.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Jo koi qurbaani karne ki taaqat rakhta ho lekin qurbaani na kare, use humaari namaz ki jagah ke qareeb na aana chaahiye.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنِ الضَّحَايَا، أَوَاجِبَةٌ هِيَ قَالَ ضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَجَرَتْ بِهِ السُّنَّةُ ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَرْطَاةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَبَلَةُ بْنُ سُحَيْمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated that Muhammad bin Sirin said:“I asked Ibn ‘Umar about sacrifices and whether they are obligatory. He said: ‘The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the Muslims after him offered sacrifices, and this is the Sunnah.’” Another chain reports exactly the same
26.hi: Hazrat Muhammad bin Sirin bayaan karte hain: Maine Ibn Umar se qurbaaniyon ke baare mein poocha aur kya woh farz hain. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) aur unke baad Musalmanon ne qurbaaniyaan dein, aur yeh Sunnat hai.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو رَمْلَةَ، عَنْ مِخْنَفِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا وُقُوفًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ بِعَرَفَةَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ عَلَى كُلِّ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ فِي كُلِّ عَامٍ أُضْحِيَّةً وَعَتِيرَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْعَتِيرَةُ هِيَ الَّتِي يُسَمِّيهَا النَّاسُ الرَّجَبِيَّةَ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated that Mikhnaf bin Sulaim said:“We were standing with the Prophet (ﷺ) at ‘Arafat and he said: ‘O people, each family, each year, must offer Udhiyah and ‘Atirah.’
26.hi: Hazrat Mikhnaf bin Sulaim bayaan karte hain: Hum Nabi (ﷺ) ke saath Arafat mein khade the aur unhone farmaya: Ae logo, har khaandaan ko, har saal, Udhiyah aur Atirah dena chaahiye.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا عَمِلَ ابْنُ آدَمَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ عَمَلاً أَحَبَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مِنْ هِرَاقَةِ دَمٍ وَإِنَّهُ لَيَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِقُرُونِهَا وَأَظْلاَفِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَا وَإِنَّ الدَّمَ لَيَقَعُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بِمَكَانٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقَعَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ فَطِيبُوا بِهَا نَفْسًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated from ’Aishah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“The son of Adam does not do any deed on the Day of Sacrifice that is dearer to Allah than shedding blood. It will come on the Day of Resurrection with its horns and cloven hoofs and hair. Its blood is accepted by Allah before it reaches the ground. So be content when you do it.”
26.hi: Hazrat Aisha se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Aadam ka beta Qurbaani ke din koi aisa amal nahi karta jo Allah ko khoon bahaane se zyada azeez ho. Yeh Qayamat ke din apne singon, khuron, aur baalon ke saath aayega. Iska khoon zameen tak pahunchne se pehle hi Allah ke haan qabool ho jaata hai. So jab tum yeh karo to dil se khush ho jao.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلاَّمُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَائِذُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا هَذِهِ الأَضَاحِيُّ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُنَّةُ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَمَا لَنَا فِيهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِكُلِّ شَعَرَةٍ حَسَنَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَالصُّوفُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِكُلِّ شَعَرَةٍ مِنَ الصُّوفِ حَسَنَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated that Zaid bin Arqam said:“The Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, what are these sacrifices?’ He said: ‘The Sunnah of your father Ibrahim.’ They said: ‘What is there for us in them, O Messenger of Allah?’ He said: ‘For every hair, one merit.’ They said: ‘What about wool, O Messenger of Allah?’ He said: ‘For every hair of wool, one merit.’”
26.hi: Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke sahaba ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, yeh qurbaaniyaan kya hain? Unhone farmaya: Tumhaare walid Ibrahim ki Sunnat. Unhone kaha: Humein inmein kya milta hai, Allah ke Rasool? Unhone farmaya: Har baal ke badle, ek neki. Unhone kaha: Aur oon ka kya, Allah ke Rasool? Unhone farmaya: Oon ke har baal ke badle, ek neki.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ ضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ بِكَبْشٍ أَقْرَنَ فَحِيلٍ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَوَادٍ وَيَمْشِي فِي سَوَادٍ وَيَنْظُرُ فِي سَوَادٍ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sacrificed a horned, defectless ram with a black stomach, black feet and black around its eyes.”
26.hi: Hazrat Abu Sa'eed bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne ek sing waala, bina khaami waala bhera qurbaan kiya jiska pait kaala tha, paanv kaale the, aur aankhon ke aas-paas kaala tha.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ حَلْبَسٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ - صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ - إِلَى شِرَاءِ الضَّحَايَا ‏.‏ قَالَ يُونُسُ فَأَشَارَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ إِلَى كَبْشٍ أَدْغَمَ لَيْسَ بِالْمُرْتَفِعِ وَلاَ الْمُتَّضِعِ فِي جِسْمِهِ فَقَالَ لِي اشْتَرِ لِي هَذَا ‏.‏ كَأَنَّهُ شَبَّهَهُ بِكَبْشِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏.‏
26.en: Yunus bin Maisarah bin Halbas said:“I went out with Abu Sa’eed Az- Zuraqi, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), to buy animals or sacrifice.” Yunus said: “Abu Sa’eed pointed to a ram that had some blackness around its ears and jaw, and was neither too big nor too small, and said to me: ‘Buy this one for them, as it seems to resemble the ram of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).’”
26.hi: Hazrat Yunus bin Maisarah bin Halbas bayaan karte hain: Main Abu Sa'eed az-Zuraqi, Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke ek sahabi, ke saath nikla jaanwar ya qurbaani khareedne. Yunus kehte hain: Abu Sa'eed ne ek bhere ki taraf ishaara kiya jiske kaanon aur jabde ke aas-paas kuch kaalapan tha, aur woh na bahut bada tha na bahut chhota, aur mujhse kaha: Inke liye isse khareedo, kyunki yeh Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke bhere se milta-julta lagta hai.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَائِذٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سُلَيْمَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ الْكَفَنِ الْحُلَّةُ وَخَيْرُ الضَّحَايَا الْكَبْشُ الأَقْرَنُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated from Abu Umamah Al-Bahili that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The best of shrouds is a two piece Najrani garment and the best of sacrifices is a horned ram.”
26.hi: Hazrat Abu Umamah al-Bahili se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Sabse behtareen kafan do tukdon waala Najrani kapda hai aur sabse behtareen qurbaani ek sing waala bhera hai.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَدِيَّةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَنْبَأَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، عَنْ عِلْبَاءَ بْنِ أَحْمَرَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فِي سَفَرٍ فَحَضَرَ الأَضْحَى فَاشْتَرَكْنَا فِي الْجَزُورِ عَنْ عَشَرَةٍ وَالَبَقَرَةِ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ ‏.‏
26.en: it was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:“We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey, and the (day of) Al-Adha came. We (sacrificed) one camel on behalf of ten (people) and one cow on behalf of seven.”
26.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas bayaan karte hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath safar mein the, aur Al-Adha ka din aaya. Humne das logon ki taraf se ek oont aur saat logon ki taraf se ek gaay qurbaan ki.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَحَرْنَا بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ الْبَدَنَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ وَالْبَقَرَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated that Jabir said:“We offered sacrifices at Al- Hudaibiyah with the Prophet (ﷺ), a camel on behalf of seven (people) and a cow on behalf of seven.”
26.hi: Hazrat Jabir bayaan karte hain: Humne Al-Hudaibiyah mein Nabi (ﷺ) ke saath qurbaaniyaan dein, saat logon ki taraf se ek oont aur saat ki taraf se ek gaay.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ ذَبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ عَمَّنِ اعْتَمَرَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ بَقَرَةً بَيْنَهُنَّ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slaughtered a cow on behalf of all his wives who had performed ‘Umrah, during the Farewell Pilgrimage.”
26.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apni sab biwiyon ki taraf se, jinhone Umrah kiya tha, Hajjat-ul-Wida ke daur mein ek gaay zibah ki.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَاضِرٍ الأَزْدِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَلَّتِ الإِبِلُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَنْحَرُوا الْبَقَرَ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:“Camels became scarce at the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), so he commanded them to sacrifice cows.”
26.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke daur mein oont kam ho gaye, so unhone gaayein qurbaan karne ka hukum diya.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ السَّرْحِ الْمِصْرِيُّ أَبُو طَاهِرٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ نَحَرَ عَنْ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ بَقَرَةً وَاحِدَةً ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sacrificed one cow during the Farewell Pilgrimage on behalf of the family of Muhammad (ﷺ)
26.hi: Hazrat Aisha se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke daur mein Muhammad (ﷺ) ke khaandaan ki taraf se ek gaay qurbaan ki.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ الْبُرْسَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ الْخُرَاسَانِيُّ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّ عَلَىَّ بَدَنَةً وَأَنَا مُوسِرٌ بِهَا وَلاَ أَجِدُهَا فَأَشْتَرِيَهَا ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَنْ يَبْتَاعَ سَبْعَ شِيَاهٍ فَيَذْبَحَهُنَّ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that a man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said:“I have to offer a sacrifice and I can afford it, but I cannot find (a camel) to buy.” The Prophet (ﷺ) told him to buy seven sheep and slaughter them
26.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai: Ek aadmi Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Mujhe qurbaani deni hai aur main iski taaqat rakhta hoon, lekin mujhe khareedne ko nahi mil raha. Nabi (ﷺ) ne unhein saat bakriyaan khareedne aur zibah karne ko kaha.

26.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَنَحْنُ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ مِنْ تِهَامَةَ فَأَصَبْنَا إِبِلاً وَغَنَمًا فَعَجِلَ الْقَوْمُ فَأَغْلَيْنَا الْقُدُورَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُقْسَمَ فَأَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَأُكْفِئَتْ ثُمَّ عَدَلَ الْجَزُورَ بِعَشَرَةٍ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ ‏.‏
26.en: It was narrated that Rafi’ bin Khadij said:“We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in Dhul-Hulaifah in (the land of) Tihamah. We acquired sheep and camels and the people hastened to put cooking pots on the fires before they had been distributed. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us and ordered that they be overturned,* then he made one camel equivalent to ten sheep.”
26.hi: Hazrat Rafi bin Khadij bayaan karte hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath Dhul-Hulaifah mein the, Tihamah ke ilaqe mein.
